Hi Aditya —

Thanks for reaching out. Useful to meet — we’re evaluating Redwood as part of a pilot to replace our current in-house inference for patient-message summarization and clinician triage. Short answers below:

- Primary use case: automated triage summaries and priority tagging for inbound patient messages (medical support inbox).
- Expected traffic: roughly 50k inference calls/day in steady state; for pilot we expect 5–10k/day. Peak concurrency for pilot likely ~40–60 concurrent calls.
- Avg tokens/request: ~350 tokens (prompt + expected completion).
- Pilot timeline: looking to kick off a 6–8 week pilot starting mid-Oct; procurement/PO in progress.
- Compliance: HIPAA required, we will need SOC2 evidence and details on data residency and retention.

I attached a short requirements doc with current payload examples (echo_requirements.pdf). Priya (cc’d) is our Head of Platform and will join the meeting for security/arch questions.

Wed 9/8 14:00 ET works for us — can we do a 45-min session instead so Priya can join? If you need a different time, Tue 9/7 10am ET also might work.

—Liam
